title: Product Update 2026 Issue 9: PDFs in Panes, Local Export, and #Template variables
summary: Discover Workflowy’s latest updates: read PDFs beside notes, automate desktop exports, use template variables, and enjoy faster, smoother panes.
body_markdown:
Hello,


Here’s what’s new in Workflowy. Read PDFs beside your notes, export your outline automatically on desktop, and let templates fill in details like today’s date or your name. Plus, lots of improvements.


## ****PDFs in Panes****


Read a PDF beside your outline so you can take notes or check a reference without losing your place.


Hold Ctrl on Windows or Linux, or Cmd on a Mac, and click a PDF. If you’re already previewing it, click **Open in pane** in the header.


Available in desktop browsers and the desktop[apps](https://u59584927.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.YHu9oLF8HiZMQftjxBRygcS09CvK4n0svbYJ7BsQ3SXsarP9BRXS7YvbL800s9xSYI12rhlpaijimIB4bLcdAwMoiSgWk3Dq2pdRd1bgORKqqQOZd9KsUByHoL5tvyejVhB2cH4vtxXiNZC7vDQIqg-3D-3DKUPA_s4s3CAiQifknn9tUfiEZ-2FY0rck63HayqPNewntOY-2FxRnjMMGy3aGo6q9uvMhFNsoo0YcZj0tyqdMcFZze6YHtIUfJJk6a7btvOxT0n72Ihb0uJMp99-2BQDajBgyH5-2FrcY4aofopw-2B0kBN2KhEFoovCgLbhOoNj6jwofebIlbAfBFWigaXce-2BvB6T28Dc5gKR1BrjsdE6oqThzAvtjiZ5nLaE9aWd1rwCR0mEfeZWfgXa-2Bj4-2BCZelAMySjBrTItPbxJl8Dwi845XMMt7qVawxPNwwl4V8k76u4kdkgu4KjcAvN5FRvBB60jH1RdAk-2F5XPg) .


## ******#Template variables******


Add variables to a[#Template](https://u59584927.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.YHu9oLF8HiZMQftjxBRygSzUF5RE7mKSAhuODun1WZNUxrs1D0SIE-2BTij7cpduh3kJ-2BUKJUrd5FLA5KJO-2Bglpjkp05lm9XCa7B3rtbLF2wTtz4Vgwo7GhgILMKvDqxMVx5JRp6TDQQmA2LwaBs-2BfCg-3D-3DGlJo_s4s3CAiQifknn9tUfiEZ-2FY0rck63HayqPNewntOY-2FxRnjMMGy3aGo6q9uvMhFNsoo0YcZj0tyqdMcFZze6YHtIUfJJk6a7btvOxT0n72Ihb0uJMp99-2BQDajBgyH5-2FrcY4aofopw-2B0kBN2KhEFoovCt5mFEZU-2B-2BaXnNPydMvus1YYFLwiZIsNoMBe4nDXRupdev-2BKrefYwraKy8zR-2BIxuxOaeOKIg5UE-2BlNwwDst3BI8G07-2FYKPgKjy6OHDM-2Bbh7Shal-2BOhQNSGs6sKzjWhdXZHg5J1gztISItTqe7XSZRO-2Bo78cnOPe1Hyab05aT7LOp) , and each new copy can automatically include details like today’s date or the name of the person who made it.


Try **{{ today }}** to date a daily journal entry or **{{ now }}** to timestamp meeting notes.


In a shared node, use **{{ user_mention }}** to tag whoever makes the copy. You can also use **{{ user_name }}** , **{{ user_initials }}** , or **{{ user_email }}** .


Variables work in the titles and notes of nested bullets, too. Click your template button or use /Add from template to make a copy.


New to templates?[Read the templates guide](https://u59584927.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.YHu9oLF8HiZMQftjxBRygSzUF5RE7mKSAhuODun1WZNUxrs1D0SIE-2BTij7cpduh3kJ-2BUKJUrd5FLA5KJO-2Bglpjkp05lm9XCa7B3rtbLF2wTtz4Vgwo7GhgILMKvDqxMVx5JRp6TDQQmA2LwaBs-2BfCg-3D-3D1WMF_s4s3CAiQifknn9tUfiEZ-2FY0rck63HayqPNewntOY-2FxRnjMMGy3aGo6q9uvMhFNsoo0YcZj0tyqdMcFZze6YHtIUfJJk6a7btvOxT0n72Ihb0uJMp99-2BQDajBgyH5-2FrcY4aofopw-2B0kBN2KhEFoovClDHU8CV0NejrdtawWPeP-2F21wWuxuI35UCd9GtR4u6n5PKkkj4OLc9ZpJlBYJ4H98abxNDWTZwE1oxucclSFi3tfLPKtfFO3O6E3py4Y8Jfbugx5VOIu6pZjSzPxaMqpWyxecQh0zbjCYx2WQwQEVkRcHDyn-2Fu5hRv5xu3sr3JKS) .


## ******Automatic Local Export******


The Workflowy[desktop app](https://u59584927.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.YHu9oLF8HiZMQftjxBRygcS09CvK4n0svbYJ7BsQ3SXsarP9BRXS7YvbL800s9xSYI12rhlpaijimIB4bLcdAwMoiSgWk3Dq2pdRd1bgORKqqQOZd9KsUByHoL5tvyejVhB2cH4vtxXiNZC7vDQIqg-3D-3DhnIZ_s4s3CAiQifknn9tUfiEZ-2FY0rck63HayqPNewntOY-2FxRnjMMGy3aGo6q9uvMhFNsoo0YcZj0tyqdMcFZze6YHtIUfJJk6a7btvOxT0n72Ihb0uJMp99-2BQDajBgyH5-2FrcY4aofopw-2B0kBN2KhEFoovCqJMvCx4fbMv-2BPtNAVUW-2BJSw6WrsMSwnrbab-2BOt0tOF7ps77tDCOCAqivT5B-2FxMdkDfBRsVmBKXunWC-2FoIgs4sLKJHRLDfo0o9R1fV0ixhYIuZBZmz3fqejpKNoKyLNJgC9vZcjDGkuGuYPknrH1m3c7EmtzjpvvUYuhGFUIn6CL) can now export a daily copy of your outline to your computer.


Open **Settings** and turn on **Local Export** . Pick a folder, set a time, and choose how many automatic copies to keep. You can also make a manual export whenever you like.


Exports include your outline in OPML and JSONL formats. Paste from the OPML copy to bring back layouts such as boards, tables, and to-dos.


Uploaded files are excluded (for now).


## **Pane improvements**


- **Open a bullet between[panes](https://u59584927.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.YHu9oLF8HiZMQftjxBRygSzUF5RE7mKSAhuODun1WZNDQF6DPDFK5P42zpI081-2BmliuiMvO-2FkH-2FDrSSNfU7u7duhrgQzNLixURr33bjbHRU8mdRvR9vlxAXzoYCjaE02B-2Bg9rt-2BcMejLD0rxF17UWQ-3D-3DDS5y_s4s3CAiQifknn9tUfiEZ-2FY0rck63HayqPNewntOY-2FxRnjMMGy3aGo6q9uvMhFNsoo0YcZj0tyqdMcFZze6YHtIUfJJk6a7btvOxT0n72Ihb0uJMp99-2BQDajBgyH5-2FrcY4aofopw-2B0kBN2KhEFoovCgdLbAk-2BhkqvSU3wLG6z23BoNYpTfq-2B9DCw5aziX7g1vNsDBkT9Ot-2BvQ-2FIGLAx9DLOzEijGUlHJIX1OFkO8uHhRJoMQwSLSdeREdQp1pDvY0YVpilnQb8hf4DEYe65d7qr2sQUNqYL4-2FUgiX2bp6zRdtflhHbsawRdudmkOSTwSA)** : Drop a bullet onto the divider to open it in a new pane. The bullet stays in its original location.
- **Pane layout** : Double-click a divider to swap neighboring panes. Workflowy also remembers your chosen pane widths after a reload.
- **Pane navigation** : Back and Forward restore your scroll position in each pane. Branches you open or close keep their state as you zoom around.
- **Tag searches** : Hold Shift and click a tag to add it to or remove it from the search in every open outline pane. Each pane keeps its other search terms.
- **[Shortcuts](https://u59584927.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.YHu9oLF8HiZMQftjxBRygUrOta4SEaoKHdVGjJHrnL7jiq6LgWWJe3w-2FF7UmW-2B3JaoZ-2BuVj1y9XSjehnr2vanM0by0NU3drQU5iV4lb03zWAYNOCuUyk9d8XvgxIeYscPOjyV4GgDkSVJHflHmX38G57jQYyv-2FBJGJVPrJbaLJtLi-2FHuRSRSnXDG-2Fhr8xBWH7oOgDVIFkHUzTopEIXnXOaP2Ev56gZ1p9E6CC4dQ-2BTk-3DALqB_s4s3CAiQifknn9tUfiEZ-2FY0rck63HayqPNewntOY-2FxRnjMMGy3aGo6q9uvMhFNsoo0YcZj0tyqdMcFZze6YHtIUfJJk6a7btvOxT0n72Ihb0uJMp99-2BQDajBgyH5-2FrcY4aofopw-2B0kBN2KhEFoovCnYguQmrv6hUVMq-2FvXS5CeRKfK3EM0DAorj7LWvS-2BZRdl-2FL67hVAofoFI4kq5kCamnNnjeae-2BUij-2F13Eat6dgrvvxUTH0iGQWE0BezzbQ80oklcfWmGkyqYepSN0PPAk7YcSdZceRojiT4D4IKdi0kIV1vgKYstxkLclPVLeC-2FgJ)** : Shortcuts assigned in a secondary pane still work after you navigate away or reload.
- **Pane performance** : Workflowy stays more responsive when you edit or move bullets with many panes open, and closing a pane takes less time.
